description: A label applied by an approved community labeler to a post, profile, or trade listing. Mirrored to AT Protocol so labels are portable and verifiable across instances. The labeler author must own an approved org.swappulse.communityLabeler record whose labelValues include the labelValue.

main.description: A community-applied label on a piece of content.

labelerId.description: Local id of the CommunityLabeler that applied this label

labelerName.description: Cached display name of the labeler

subjectUri.description: at:// URI of the record being labeled

authorDid.description: DID of the labeler author (for bridging)
